scripts.mysql:start: powershell -Command "Start-Process 'C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysqld.exe' -ArgumentList '--defaults-file=C:\xampp\mysql\bin\my.ini --standalone' -WorkingDirectory 'C:\xampp\mysql' -WindowStyle Hidden; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Write-Host '✓ MySQL iniciado correctamente en 127.0.0.1:3306'"
scripts.mysql:stop: powershell -Command "Stop-Process -Name mysqld -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host '✓ MySQL detenido'"
